canonical_corpus_definition: CANONICAL_CORPUS_DEFINITION (benchmark-contract corpus): the complete union of official 2WikiMultiHopQA v1.0 (ids_april2021) context paragraphs over train + dev + test, one node per distinct paragraph TITLE (exact string); text = ' '.join(sentences). Independent of which queries are evaluated. The separate full-universe corpus (para_with_hyperlink, 5,989,847 articles; data/canonical/2wiki_universe) is a different, out-of-scope corpus.

eval_subset.recovery_method: legacy 2wiki_clean questions came from the FlashRAG 15k train sample (raw file no longer present); matched to official train/dev/test by EXACT question text; ambiguities resolved by supporting-fact title set == legacy gold title set

node_id_scheme: 2wiki:<sha256(title)[:24]> (title = exact official string); file order = lexicographic node_id

normalization_rules.stored_text: EXACT official string; no NFC/NFKC, no case-folding, no whitespace collapsing, no stripping
normalization_rules.identity_keys: EXACT strings (see dedup_policy); lossy alternatives are only quantified in integrity_report.corpus_accounting_detail.identity_normalization_diagnostics, never applied

construction_steps.2wiki: text = ' '.join(sentences) -- the official file stores a sentence list
construction_steps.metaqa: text = entity name (no verbalization at corpus level)

normalization_rules.encoding: UTF-8, JSON with ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, LF line endings

dedup_policy: identity = exact title; first occurrence (train->dev->test, file order) fixes the text; 0 titles carry conflicting text across their 1,926,060 occurrences. 86 distinct titles share an identical text -- kept as distinct nodes (text-hash identity would merge unrelated articles).

legacy_comparison.evidence: legacy corpus = union of the 10 context paragraphs of the 15,000 FlashRAG-sampled official TRAIN questions (data/raw/2wiki.jsonl -> loaders.load_2wiki -> build_clean), 150,000 records -> 65,865 (title, md5) nodes. The eval subset (2,000) is a random 20% 'val' cut of those same 15,000 questions, so the corpus is a function of the query sample. 398,354 - 65,865 = 332,489 official paragraphs are absent. All sampled-query golds being present does NOT make this benign: distractor mass, partition structure and reachability all depend on the sample.

downstream_artifacts_built: NONE (no embeddings / SPLADE / graphs / partitions / indexes) -- by design of this track

LEGACY_CONTINUITY.provenance: the frozen legacy evaluation subset of substrate '2wiki_clean', recovered onto canonical query ids. Rows = data/ukb_storage/2wiki_clean/gte_qwen/query_ids_all.json indexed by split_indices['val'] (scratchpad/_ta_comb.py:75-92, _ta_resid.py:63-76); the 'val' cut itself comes from src/experiments/overlap_retrain.py:171-206 _splits(). Recovery method: legacy 2wiki_clean questions came from the FlashRAG 15k train sample (raw file no longer present); matched to official train/dev/test by EXACT question text; ambiguities resolved by supporting-fact title set == legacy gold title set. Recovered 2000/2000, missed 0.
LEGACY_CONTINUITY.labelling: TRAIN-DERIVED -- NOT A VALID HELD-OUT EVAL SET. These are a seeded 20% cut of OFFICIAL TRAIN (random.Random(42), 70/20/10 split in src/experiments/overlap_retrain.py::_splits, used because these questions carry no official split metadata). Use ONLY for paired legacy->canonical continuity analysis; never quote as accuracy.

QUALITY_LOCKED.provenance: the complete official 2wiki DEV split, taken verbatim from the official source files; official 2wiki TEST answers are HIDDEN, so dev (12,576) is the only proper held-out labelled split.
QUALITY_LOCKED.labelling: OFFICIAL HELD-OUT LABELLED -- the lane for final accuracy and significance testing. Disjoint from LEGACY_CONTINUITY unless noted.

SCALE_ALL.record_source: queries/<split>.jsonl (already materialized in full; the lane file is the ordered id+split index, so no query record is duplicated on disk)
SCALE_ALL.provenance: every official query of every released split of the dataset, as parsed by scratchpad/final_canonical_build/build.py's query stage from the official source files.
SCALE_ALL.labelling: MIXED SPLITS -- scale / latency / robustness only. Contains train questions and (where the official test labels are hidden) unlabelled questions; never quote as accuracy.

corpus_hash_equality_assertion.how_bookkeeping: one nodes.jsonl serves every lane; CORPUS_HASH recomputed from nodes.jsonl in this script and compared against dataset_manifest / integrity_report / build_info
corpus_hash_equality_assertion.how_constructive: the corpus was rebuilt from the official sources under three DIFFERENT --eval-subset arguments (legacy / random_dev:7 / none) and produced an identical CORPUS_HASH each time
